dataset: PXD014017 (Cancer Res Commun 2023, IFNg remodeling of CRC PDO immunopeptidome)
perturbation: IFN-gamma machinery-state INDUCTION (immunoproteasome PSMB8/9/10 + TAP + ERAP up); NOT genetic KO-collapse

ligand_stratification.method: length 8-12 AND NetMHCpan BAminRank<=2.0 (rank%) vs the PDO's OWN BAmostlikely allele

processing_feature: immunoproteasome C-terminal + P1' cleavage-context preference (HLA-agnostic residue chemistry; identical function in every background)
remodeling_label: binary gained(IFNg-only)=1 vs lost(UT-only)=0 among genuine ligands; continuous log2(Peptidomics_FC) for both-present robustness

leave_organoid_out.PRIMARY_metric: data-driven C-terminal gained-fraction table; MEAN of per-fold AUROC (base-rate-free) across the 3 A*02-negative disjoint backgrounds

secondary_fixed_immunoproteasome_prior.note: hand-coded immunoproteasome C-term chemistry prior (biased); pooled AUROC + continuous log2FC rho

strict_disjoint_sensitivity.note: held-out PDO re-scored EXCLUDING peptides on an allele it shares with a training PDO (CRC-01 & CRC-05 share A*32:01) -> removes shared-allele leakage. This is the TRUE cross-DISJOINT-allele transfer.

leakage_note: Transfer feature is a fixed HLA-agnostic residue-chemistry function; the fit never sees held-out peptides. CRC-01 & CRC-05 share ONE allele (A*32:01); CRC-04 is fully disjoint. All three are A*02-negative -> disjoint from the KO-cluster. The single shared A*32:01 (CRC-01/CRC-05) is a minor optimism source; CRC-04 fold is fully clean.

_meta.purpose: REFRAMED cross-allele H4 gate: does IFN-gamma machinery-INDUCTION immunopeptidome remodeling transfer across 3 A*02-negative, allele-disjoint CRC PDO backgrounds (PXD014017)? Reframes the KO-collapse gate, which is structurally untestable cross-allele on public data (all hard-essential-KO immunopeptidome is A*02).
_meta.data_provenance: PXD014017 / Cancer Res Commun 2023 'Multifactorial Remodeling of the Cancer Immunopeptidome by IFNgamma' (PMID 37991387, PMC10655636). Per-PDO supplementary Excel s01/s02/s03 (RNA+protein+PROCESSED immunopeptide tables, +IFNg vs untreated). Fetched via EuropePMC supplementaryFiles (7.8/5.8/2.9 MB); NO 640/345 MB PRIDE MaxQuant zip pulled, NO raw reprocessing. Intermediates deleted.
_meta.why_this_is_a_valid_reframe: IFN-gamma is a genuine antigen-processing MACHINERY perturbation (induces immunoproteasome PSMB8/9/10 + TAP + ERAP). The 3 PDOs are A*02-NEGATIVE and allele-diverse, so they supply the disjoint-allele test the KO axis structurally cannot.

HONEST_scope_statement.what_this_PROVES: On 3 A*02-negative, allele-diverse CRC PDOs, an HLA-agnostic C-terminal machinery-processing signal transfers cross-organoid at a STATISTICALLY-SIGNIFICANT but TINY level (mean-per-fold AUROC 0.544, permutation p=0.021). i.e. there IS a shared, machinery-linked component to which peptides IFN-gamma turns on/off, detectable across disjoint alleles.
what_this_does_NOT_prove: It is NOT a KO-collapse test. IFN-gamma INDUCES/diversifies presentation (gain-of-machinery); B2M/TAP/TAPBP KO ABLATES it (loss-of-machinery). The sign, magnitude, and mechanism differ. This gate cannot substitute for the hard-essential presentation-COLLAPSE readout the CRO targets.
The transfer is FAR too weak to carry a cross-allele generalization claim. AUROC 0.544 is ~4pp above chance; a claim strong enough to replace a wet experiment needs >=0.65.

The IFN-gamma remodeling DIRECTION is dominated by each PDO's OWN HLA anchor preference, not a shared immunoproteasome signature: the fixed immunoproteasome-chemistry prior FAILS (pooled AUROC 0.405; continuous log2FC rho -0.31, p=0.74). Hydrophobic/aromatic C-termini are gained in CRC-01 & CRC-05 (whose alleles favour them) but NOT in CRC-04 (A*03/A*24/B*35/B*18 favour basic K/R; W is gained LEAST there). The 'machinery signal' does not cleanly separate from allele-motif remodeling.

Part of the small positive signal is shared-allele leakage: CRC-01 & CRC-05 share A*32:01. On STRICT-disjoint scoring (excluding shared-allele peptides) the mean falls to 0.537 and the two fully-disjoint-scored folds collapse to chance (CRC-04 0.520, CRC-05-disjoint 0.503).
HONEST_scope_statement.bottom_line: A weak, partly-leakage-driven, machinery-induction remodeling signal transfers cross-allele; genuine cross-DISJOINT-allele transfer is essentially at chance. This does NOT establish that machinery state controls presentation cross-allele strongly enough to size down the hard-essential-KO decision.

CRO_implication.does_public_data_reduce_or_eliminate_the: NO — the reframed public-data test does NOT reduce or eliminate the KO-collapse CRO for the hard-essential claim.
reasoning: The specific claim the CRO underwrites is HARD-ESSENTIAL presentation COLLAPSE (B2M/TAP/TAPBP KO -> presentation ablated) generalizing across disjoint alleles. IFN-gamma induction is the opposite perturbation direction and cannot test collapse.

Even as a machinery-STATE proxy, the cross-allele transfer here is significant-but-tiny (0.544) and mostly evaporates on strict-disjoint scoring (0.537, fully-disjoint folds ~0.50). It does not demonstrate a strong, allele-independent machinery->presentation map.

So the H4_GATE_CORRECTED_VERDICT conclusion stands: the CRO is still required to supply hard-essential KO on >=3 disjoint-allele backgrounds with a consistent IP method + matched proteome + verified-complete KO + absolute quant.
CRO_implication.what_the_public_data_DID_buy: It cheaply RULED OUT the optimistic hope that free IFN-gamma organoid data could substitute for the KO-collapse CRO. It also produced a useful negative mechanistic finding: IFN-gamma repertoire remodeling is allele-motif-dominated, not a portable immunoproteasome C-term signature -> reinforces that presentation-machinery effects must be measured PER allele background, exactly the CRO's disjoint-allele design requirement.
